fields.statement: At 7cf32ec6 I read the diff of cfe2054e and 7cf32ec6. Before the ff-only pull, dropIncomingLogCopies in internal/api/ship_close.go fetches origin/main, lists the untracked .rhiza/log files and removes only those whose hash-object equals origin/main:<path>. I ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ship-close-out -count=1 and it passed. In ship-close-out-log-copies.txtar, case 1 opens a change set with change new in the main checkout and merges it through a clone. close-out exits 0 with main_updated true, HEAD equals the pushed origin/main, and git status shows no untracked .rhiza/log. Case 2 gives the main checkout differing untracked log files. close-out exits non-zero with main_updated false, step update-main and result failed. The untracked list is unchanged, and cmp shows each file's bytes are the same. This answers attempt 1's finding. Mutation check: in a scratch copy with the dropIncomingLogCopies call removed, the script fails at case 1 (main_updated false). In make check, fmt-check, vet and test pass. self-check fails only on a stale .rhiza/rendered/actor/claude-code-f7650bc4.md and index.md. That file came from 3d6fd44c on the other leaf, close-out-retry-after-forget, not from this leaf's diff.
